text:
deploy-bot: Deployment started: release/weights-2026-03-17-1 -> prod (canary us-west). Artifact=weightset-v12, tokenizer=latest-tokenizer (alias -> v3.4). Feature-flag `new_token_lookup` enabled for 10%
monitor-bot: Metric alert: service=model-serving-canary-us-west error_rate(tokenize_error)=0.012 > threshold 0.005. Spike detected across 3 instances.
incident-bot: Pager opened: INC-2026-1767777777 sev=2. Paging oncall.
sarah: saw 502s and garbled tokens in the canary logs, sample: "[WARN] tokenizer failed to map token id 0xFF". Investigating logs.
aj: I'm oncall, pausing rollout now. flipping flag `new_token_lookup` -> false (10% -> 0%).
deploy-bot: Rollout paused. Canary traffic draining. No new hosts will pick up weightset-v12.
mike: quick debug: weightset-v12 was built against tokenizer v3.3 ABI. `latest-tokenizer` alias was repointed to v3.4 yesterday by infra-pipeline. Alias mismatch caused index shift.
sarah: customer impact check: generation endpoint /v1/generate in us-west saw 1.7% fail rate last 5m, ~0.3% user-visible errors on product. CSE notified.
aj: initiating rollback plan: pin tokenizer alias back to v3.3 and roll canaries to weightset-v11. Applying kill-switch on bad artifact.
deploy-bot: Command run: `infractl rollout cancel --artifact weightset-v12 --group canary-us-west`
mike: smoke test on rollback candidate: sample prompt id=8472 before rollback -> garbled, after -> clean. Token streams normalized.
sarah: drafting customer advisory: "We observed a partial degradation due to a tokenizer alias mismatch during today's rollout. Root cause identified and rollback in progress." Sending to CSE for review.
aj: creating incident page with timeline + log snippets, tagging SRE and Eng-ML. Handoff to night oncall @linda in 15m. 
linda: acknowledged, will monitor until stable.
incident-bot: Update: rollback confirmed complete on canary group. error_rate(tokenize_error)=0.001 now under threshold.
aj: postmortem checklist: 1) pin tokenizer alias in release CI 2) add preflight that verifies tokenizer/weight ABI compatibility 3) add rollback playbook steps. Assign owners.
cse-john: tracking open customers, pushing advisory to affected accounts.
mike: follow-up: will add deterministic artifact validation hash between weights and tokenizer build metadata. ETA EOD.
aj: closing pager once all regions confirm stable. leaving notes for @linda handoff.
